log: LOOP 148b -- POST-HOC controls on loop 148. Written after seeing its output, and labelled as such.
loop 148 recorded 4/7 and a requirement of 20.29x. Nothing below changes those gates.
L1 THE HOLE IN LOOP 148's OWN K5
K5 printed rho(pubs, Ly fold-range) = -0.3648 and struck on nothing, because its predeclared handling was written for K2's envelope only.
The strike threshold since loop 137 is |rho| >= 0.2. 0.3648 is past it. That control was computed and then not connected to anything --
the same family of error as loop 147's gate ORDER flaw, and it is recorded here as a flaw in loop 148 rather than quietly fixed.
receptor median fold-range 1.51x
vs ABUNDANCE-matched null  median 1.61x   receptors at the 20.4% percentile
vs PUBLICATION-matched null median 1.37x   receptors at the 89.6% percentile
receptor median pubs 122 against a proteome median 98 -- they ARE better published, which is exactly the confound.
gate: K3's FAIL stands only if 1.51x is below 20.29x under BOTH nulls. It is 1.51x either way.
the two nulls disagree on DIRECTION (20% vs 90%) and abundance is the mechanistic one, since fold-range noise is driven by intensity and fame is only a
proxy for it. They agree on the thing that matters: 1.5x is not 20.3x under either, so fame does not rescue the receptors and K3's FAIL is real.
L1 PASS
L2 THE CHANNEL CHECK ON CDC20
K3's median FAILED and stays failed. One receptor in the PREDECLARED set moved: CDC20 at 19.65x against a requirement of 20.29x.
Loop 144 withdrew a 526-gene list for being LFQ-only. Same rule, applied here before the number is allowed to mean anything.
LFQ   19.65x   peak F5  trough F1   99.91% percentile of 6,553   (5 proteins reach 20.3x)
rawIntensity   39.72x   peak F5  trough F1   95.60% percentile of 7,884   (560 proteins reach 20.3x)
iBAQ   39.72x   peak F5  trough F1   95.60% percentile of 7,884   (560 proteins reach 20.3x)
present in all three channels: True;  same peak and trough in all three: True;  above the 95%th percentile in all three: True
the swing is LARGER in raw Intensity than in LFQ, which is the opposite of loop 144's failure mode. But raw Intensity carries 2.01x the per-point noise, so many more
proteins clear 20.3x there and CDC20's PERCENTILE falls from 99.91% to 95.60%. The percentile is the comparable statistic and both readings are reported.
CDC20 pubs 425, the 93.5th percentile -- it is a famous gene, and a fold-range measured on a mass spectrometer is not something fame can
manufacture. It was named in loop 148's APC_ACTIVATORS constant in the commit BEFORE the run, which git can check.
L2 PASS
L3 THE REGRESSION DISCREPANCY: 77 OSCILLATORS WHERE LOOP 123 RECORDED 80
duplicate gene names are the cause. Loop 123 keeps the row with the LARGEST 3-phase fold; loop 148 keeps the first row.
loop 123's rule (max fold):  80 genes   median A 0.4453   required 20.29x
loop 148's rule (first row): 77 genes   median A 0.4451   required 20.28x
loop 123's rule selects the most-oscillating row of each duplicate, which biases the set upward. Loop 148's does not, which is why it is the smaller set.
gate: recover 80 under loop 123's rule (80) AND the two rules agree to 1% (True)
the choice does not move the answer. K0(e)'s 1% tolerance on two statistics hid a 4% difference in the SET, and that is worth knowing even when it changes nothing.
L3 PASS
L4 WHAT K6's PERCENTILE CHOICE HID
77 required rates against the measured envelope of 4,821 rates:
below   p99 of the envelope (0.155 /h):    0.0%
below p99.9 of the envelope (0.767 /h):   81.8%
below   max of the envelope (1.386 /h):   98.7%
median requirement 0.487 /h; fastest rate the assay measured 1.386 /h
K6 chose p99 before the run and its FAIL stands. But 0.0% below p99 and 81.8%-level figures below p99.9 are the same distribution read at two cuts, and reporting only the
first makes the requirement sound unreachable when it sits BETWEEN the 99th and 99.9th percentile of rates the machine already delivers at rest.
L4 PASS
L1  PASS
L2  PASS
L3  PASS
L4  PASS

corrections.what_was_claimed: present in all three channels (LFQ, raw Intensity, iBAQ)
corrections.what_is_true: iBAQ is raw Intensity divided by a per-protein peptide count, so the constant cancels in any across-fraction ratio; median per-protein CV of Intensity/iBAQ across the six fractions is 1.02e-10 and both return 39.72x at the same 95.60th percentile because they are the same numbers.
corrections.effect: L2 is a TWO-channel check, LFQ against raw Intensity. That is what loop 144's rule demands, so the substance and the PASS both stand; one third of the arithmetic was vacuous and the word 'three' is wrong.
corrections.already_known_in_repo: loop 144 recorded 'iBAQ is not independent' and this gate was written as three channels anyway.
